page.layout: One printed page, single text column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Below the running head: thesis heading, italic thesis statement, section heading, then the running text. Foot: catchword at right, gathering signature at left. The fragment of the facing page at the far left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.head: VI Thesis.

p.i: Bonum opus, ut nostrum, extenuare, est revera Dei Gratiæ gloriam amplificare.

main_text.head: SECT. VIII.
main_text.p: Plùs valet opus ad amplificandam Dei gloriam, quò plus ejus bonitati, & potentiæ tribuitur. At cùm Pontificii in cooperatione boni operis partem potiorem sibi arrogent: Protestantes opus bonum, quatenus bonum, Deo in solidum ascribant, tanquam donum ejus spirituale & supernaturale, & quidem gratuitum, itâ ut non possit esse Meritorium apud Deum. Proinde dogma hoc, quod sta-tuit Christum meruisse nobis virtutem Meren-di, tam est utique absonum, absurdum, ac planè impium, ac si asseruerint, Christum meruisse à Deo, nè Christiani, absque opinione Meritorum suorum, spiritualia, supernaturalia, & gratuita ejus dona agnoscant.

Enimvero, inquient, Meritorum nostrorum dignitatem hoc pacto minuere, erit Christi quoque erga nos Gratiam extenuare. Imò vero, inquam, non magis, quàm Spiritus Sanctus gloriam Dei deprimit per istas μειώσεις & extenuationes, quæ frequenter admodum in Scripturis occurrunt: viz. in re militari, post adeptam victoriam, Non nobis, Domine, non

page.notes: The Greek word μειώσεις is a doubtful reading; the accent may differ on the scan. The Greek word is printed in a larger, italic-like face and the transcription is best-effort. The "Y" at the foot is the gathering signature; "non" at the lower right is the catchword. Visible show-through and faint ghost text in the upper right of the page are excluded. The left-edge fragment belongs to the facing page and is excluded. Printing "Protestantes", "Pontificii", "viz." are copied as printed; "Meren-di" and "sta-tuit" keep their printed line-end hyphens.
